cohort: The study included all patients followed at the haemophilia treatment care centre in Lyon, France, with a FXI:C < 50IU/dL, who had a baseline TGA performed between January 2014 and December 2019.
finding: Thrombin generation assay (TGA) was found to be a useful laboratory test in FXI deficiency for determining the bleeding risk and guiding the haemostatic management of surgeries, as thrombin generation was significantly reduced or delayed in patients who reported surgery-related bleeding.
